name: After § 26
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 26a. Categorically rejects the proposed reductions to the post-2027 CAP budget, its integration into the NRPPs and the removal of the second pillar; deplores the fact that any potential increase will be based solely on voluntary flexibility mechanisms, which risks bringing about distortions between the Member States; calls for a robust and earmarked CAP budget in the next MFF, maintained at no less than its current level in real terms and pegged to inflation, in order to guarantee food security, competitiveness and a fair income for farmers;
